codeReview.summary: The current replay-range validator still only balances markers inside the selected paint-record slice, so it does not satisfy VAL-SCENE-007's requirement to reject ranges that begin or end inside an already-open scoped layer.

issues.description: validateReplayRange() only iterates scene.paintRecords[range] and never accounts for scopes that were already open before range.lowerBound or still open after range.upperBound. That means a marker-free interior subrange inside an outer scoped layer, or a subrange that contains a balanced nested scope but omits the surrounding outer markers, is incorrectly accepted as .success. replay() then re-emits primitives without the required enclosing scoped-layer markers, which violates VAL-SCENE-007 and undermines VAL-SCENE-006's guarantee that balanced replay reconstructs equivalent scoped-layer structure.
